scope: FoodKing Le Cayenne V1 — indirect auth bypass via misconfiguration
method: Static analysis of routes/api.php, routes/web.php, routes/channels.php
Inspect 9 admin controllers without inline permission middleware → verify gated route-level
Inspect kiosk auto-login security gate (config/kiosk.php + AppServiceProvider)

routes_total.parser_note: 59 Route::match declarations each register 2 HTTP verbs → effective Laravel-routed surface ≈ 574 in api.php. Parser gap is single-declaration deduplication, not a hidden auth gap.

truly_public_list.justification: Browser CSP report endpoint — W3C invariant browser cannot attach apiKey header on CSP report. Throttle:1000,1. Documented at L1412-1419.

routes_without_auth_middleware.api_key_only_note: apiKey is single-static-shared-secret (X-API-KEY header validated against config('app.api_key')). It ships in every web/kiosk client bundle. Per BRAIN classification, this is defense-in-depth (blocks naive scanners) NOT user-identity gating. All 49 routes are legitimately public — login/OTP/menu-browsing/loyalty-self-enrollment/table-QR ordering.

routes_with_auth_but_no_rbac.note: Admin route prefix at L262+L276 carries auth:sanctum at group level; RBAC enforced controller-level via permission:* middleware (Spatie). Of 90 admin controllers, 9 lack inline permission middleware: all 9 verified gated at route-level OR are SPA-bootstrap blade controllers (AdminPosV4Controller with documented client-side auth pattern).

bypass_vectors_identified.description: If operator deploys production with KIOSK_MACHINE_USERNAME=kiosk-lecayenne / KIOSK_MACHINE_PASSWORD=kiosk123 (the .env.example values), the kiosk machine authenticates with trivially guessable credentials. Production boot guard does not refuse this.
bypass_vectors_identified.exploit_path: External attacker on kiosk LAN → POST /api/auth/kiosk-login with kiosk-lecayenne/kiosk123 → receives Sanctum token with kiosk:order ability → can place orders on behalf of the branch / harvest menu data with kiosk-only price visibility.
mitigation_layered: KioskMachine status field — admin can disable
branch.* broadcast channel restricted to actual machine's branch (channels.php token-name discriminator)
bypass_vectors_identified.recommendation: Add to AppServiceProvider production guard: refuse boot if KIOSK_MACHINE_PASSWORD is in known-default-list ['kiosk123','password','admin','123456']. Defer to V1.0.X cloud cutover prep — local Le Cayenne LAN-bounded V1 risk is acceptable.

verdict_rationale: Auth/RBAC architecture is mature and layered. Production boot guards (9 distinct safety checks) catch the highest-impact misconfigurations at startup. Webhook signature verification is blocking. Branch ownership enforced at multiple layers (BranchScope global + service-level user_id checks + paymentConfirm controller quadruple-defense). Permission middleware (Spatie) properly gates 17 route declarations + 90+ controller methods, with zero typos discovered. Middleware priority explicitly pinned in Kernel.php to prevent order-bypass. The 4 truly-public routes are legitimate (3 health + 1 CSP report); the 49 apiKey-only routes are by-design public catalog/auth/loyalty surfaces. Only 1 AMBER finding — H12 default kiosk creds in .env.example — already tracked V1.0.X backlog and bounded to LAN-physical-access trust model in V1. No new bypass vectors discovered.
top_5_bypass_risks_ranked: H12 (AMBER): Default kiosk creds in .env.example not boot-guarded — V1.0.X recommended addition
API key shared secret (informational): X-API-KEY ships in client bundle, single static value — defense-in-depth only, NOT user-identity gating; BRAIN treats correctly
FormRequest 67/69 sentinel ceiling (informational): 67 FormRequests still return true unconditionally, gated by route/controller permission middleware where applicable — V1.0.2 ratchet to baseline=67
AdminPosV4Controller intentional no-auth blade serve (informational): client-side auth via pos-app.js, attacker could load empty SPA but cannot reach any API without token
CACHE_DRIVER guard narrower than stated intent (BRAIN UNI-03 backlog): allows file/database in production — single-instance V1 LOCAL is safe, ALB multi-instance V2 cloud requires widening
security_depth_recommendation: Auth/RBAC has reached production-grade depth for V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne. Recommended next-phase improvements (V1.0.X, non-blocking): (1) Add KIOSK_MACHINE_PASSWORD default-rejection boot guard. (2) Ratchet FormRequestAuthzDrift sentinel baseline from 69 → 67. (3) For V2 SaaS/cloud cutover: widen CACHE_DRIVER forbidden list to ['array','null','file','database'] and rotate apiKey to per-tenant value (or replace entirely with mTLS / oauth-client-credentials grant).
